note: Raw-material rate master for the cost ESTIMATE engine (lib/costEstimate.js). The Zoho item master (org 60063687231) is fully rate-populated (2,164 items with real purchase rates), so the dominant cost drivers below are REAL Magppie rates derived from actual SKUs (source:'zoho', with the SKU + how it was reduced to a per-unit rate). A few items with no clean SKU (sink bowl, Lemans mechanism, back panel, edge band) remain source:'assumed' — any quote touching an assumed rate is still flagged ESTIMATE. Stone/board are priced per sheet/slab in Zoho with dimensions in the SKU name; per-sqft = rate / (sheet area in sqft).
